notes.text: Bracketed [Scope.Command] text is replaced at runtime. Keep every command exactly; the scope chain before the command (Root, From, event targets, IDs such as questing_knight_1) is a script identifier, not translatable text.
Formatting uses §X ... §! colour codes. Hash markers such as #P or #bold are not Stellaris formatting and display as literal text.

zh-CN.text: 中文本地化里代词命令输出他/她；中文没有主格宾格之分，任何代词命令都可作主语或宾语。
因中文习惯省略重复的代词命令是合理的，前提是指代仍然清楚；不要把代词命令写死成“他”或“她”。没有必要时，应尽量保持与原文相同的命令引用。

suffixes.Cap: same output with the first letter capitalised

scopes.From: the calling event's root scope; can be chained further back
scopes.Actor: the faction initiating a diplomatic action
scopes.Recipient: the faction targeted by a diplomatic action
scopes.Third_party: the third party in a diplomatic action
scopes.Capital: capital of the current country or sector

GetRealName.meaning: name of the scope, ignoring whether it is identified

GetAAnPlanetClass.meaning: English article a/an chosen by planet class

GetAAnSpeciesClass.meaning: English article a/an chosen by species class

GetEngineer.meaning: word for engineer, varying by empire type (normal, hive mind, machine)

GetEngineerPlural.meaning: plural word for engineers, varying by empire type

GetHasHave.meaning: English has/have chosen by the leader's gender (subject-verb agreement)

GetIsAre.meaning: English is/are chosen by the leader's gender (subject-verb agreement)

GetWasWere.meaning: English was/were chosen by the scoped leader's gender or lack of gender; pairs with pronoun commands for subject-verb agreement

GetLinguists.meaning: word for linguists, varying by empire type

GetPlanetHabitat.meaning: the word planet, moon or habitat

GetResearchers.meaning: word for researchers, varying by empire type

GetScientist.meaning: word for scientist, varying by empire type

GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment.meaning: a compliment for the species, plural

GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult.meaning: an insult for the species, plural

GetSpeciesOrganName.meaning: the species' word for an internal organ

GetStarName.meaning: name of the star of the scope's system

GetTerraformer.meaning: word for terraformer, varying by empire type

GetHerHim.meaning: pronoun her or him by gender

GetHerHis.meaning: pronoun her or his by gender

GetSheHe.meaning: pronoun she or he by gender

GetHimHer.meaning: pronoun him or her by gender (word-order variant of GetHerHim)

GetHisHer.meaning: pronoun his or her by gender (word-order variant of GetHerHis)

GetHeShe.meaning: pronoun he or she by gender (word-order variant of GetSheHe)

GetHerselfHimself.meaning: reflexive pronoun herself or himself by gender

LastKilledCountryName.meaning: name of the last killed country
